## [1.0.1](https://github.com/RyuuseiAkira/w3s-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (2026-11-25)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* make MicroG-RE support optional and remove Options column in README ([082aa52](https://github.com/RyuuseiAkira/w3s-patches/commit/082aa52496ef300feacc6e9651ff35bbea61c244))

patches.name: MicroG-RE support
patches.description: Redirects Google Play Services and Credential Manager to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) with package and signature spoofing so Google Sign-In works on re-signed builds.

patches.name: Unlimited energy
patches.description: Bypasses client-side energy consumption and always reports full energy charges.

patches.name: Unlock curriculum map
patches.description: Unlocks sequential lessons, checkpoints, and milestones on the curriculum map.
